fields.title: 📖 The Dunyā Is Not a Place of Rest
fields.body:
🖋️ **Yaḥyā b. Maʿīn** said:

***“The Dunyā is a house of unpleasant things and deaths.”***

The Dunyā is not a place of lasting rest. Whoever recognizes it as a trial does not attach his heart to it, but takes from it only what brings him to **Allah**.

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Dunyā is not a place upon which one builds one’s heart. Whoever recognizes it as a trial does not seek his rest in it, but with **Allah** and in the Hereafter.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn al-Junayd, Suʾālāt Ibn al-Junayd li-Yaḥyā b. Maʿīn, Nr. 49, S. 284
